quotes.name: Lena Cross
quotes.quote: To be honest, I've noticed Marisol Rivera's name popping up less often in conversations around Piedmont Ave, and when it does, it's usually in the context of looking back at her past work. I've seen her flyers and posters around, but they seem a bit outdated. People still speak highly of her community work, though. I think she's done some great things, but it feels like she's not as actively involved as she used to be.
